# [Frontend] feat(dashboard): replace cryptic JSON open_position with human-readable card

The SessionDetailDialog showed open_position as raw JSON.stringify(),
which users couldn't understand. Replaced with OpenPositionCard component
that displays:
- Quantity purchased and asset name
- Entry price and invested amount
- Purchase date/time
- Stop-loss and take-profit badges
- FIFO lots breakdown
- Simple explanation of what the position means

Build passes, no TypeScript errors.
